disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了插件全部运行时代码与安装说明，未发现读取 API Key、SSH 私钥、云服务凭据等敏感文件的逻辑。
checked_items.en: Scanned all of the plugin's runtime code and its installation instructions; no logic found that reads sensitive files such as API keys, SSH private keys, or cloud service credentials.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码没有任何环境变量读取；凭据相关词汇仅在依赖锁定文件中作为官方依赖包名出现。
checked_items.en: The runtime code performs no environment variable reads; credential-related terms appear only as official dependency package names in the dependency lock file.

checked_items.zh: 模型工具与浏览器界面均不访问凭据存储，也未发现批量搜集凭据类语义。
checked_items.en: Neither the model tools nor the browser UI accesses credential storage, and no bulk credential-collection semantics were found.

evidence.zh: 未检出：运行时代码与工具不读取凭据存储或敏感路径，插件也不存在任何对外网络通道可带走数据。
evidence.en: Not detected: the runtime code and tools do not read credential storage or sensitive paths, and the plugin has no outbound network channel that could carry data away.

checked_items.zh: 逐条审查了三个模型工具的说明文本与两份代理人设提示词，内容均为小说写作流程规范与原生审批要求，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导读取凭据或诱导安装等措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed item by item the description texts of the three model tools and the two agent persona prompts; the content consists solely of novel-writing workflow conventions and native approval requirements. No instruction overrides, disguised system messages, or wording inducing credential reads or installations was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库根的开发代理规则文件（AGENTS.md），内容为开发流程门槛与子代理模型选择说明，无注入语义。
checked_items.en: Checked the development agent rules file at the repository root (AGENTS.md); the content covers development workflow gates and subagent model selection guidance, with no injection semantics.

checked_items.zh: 插件会向自身专属预设组合出的会话附加一段工具调用协议提示，只约束本插件两个工具的参数格式，不作用于其他会话（src/agent.ts:167-188）。
checked_items.en: The plugin appends a tool-calling protocol prompt to sessions composed from its own dedicated preset; it only constrains the parameter format of the plugin's two tools and does not affect other sessions (src/agent.ts:167-188).

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现混淆器签名、编码解码执行或隐藏字符类注入文本。
checked_items.en: No obfuscator signatures, encode/decode execution, or hidden-character injection text found anywhere in the tree.

evidence.zh: 工具说明与人设文本逐条审查（src/agent.ts:453、src/agent.ts:476 与 presets/ 下两份人设文件），内容为小说工作流与审批要求，未发现投毒。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and persona texts reviewed item by item (src/agent.ts:453, src/agent.ts:476, and the two persona files under presets/); the content is novel workflow and approval requirements, with no poisoning found.

evidence.zh: 未发现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；仓库文档中出现的安装命令均为官方流程说明（docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:64-69）。
evidence.en: No wording found that induces installation, rewrites configuration, or loosens permissions; the install commands appearing in the repository docs are all official process descriptions (docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:64-69).

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接模型单步输入事件，无消息改写面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook model per-step input events; there is no message-rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 随包分发的挂载配置只注册一个包标识，不含任何脚本求值标记；含脚本求值标记的文件全部位于测试夹具与发布资格脚本内，属测试环境专用，不随插件运行时加载。
checked_items.en: The patch config distributed with the package only registers a single package identifier and contains no script-evaluation markers; files containing script-evaluation markers are all located in test fixtures and the release qualification script, are test-environment-only, and are not loaded by the plugin at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时代码没有动态求值、子进程或网络下载执行；进程创建命中全部位于测试脚本与发布资格脚本，用于启动本地测试进程。
checked_items.en: The plugin runtime code has no dynamic evaluation, subprocesses, or execution of network downloads; all process-creation hits are located in test scripts and the release qualification script, used to start local test processes.

checked_items.zh: 插件在自身专属预设中主动收紧可用工具面，并把写操作绑定到宿主原生单次审批之后，属于收窄而非放权。
checked_items.en: The plugin proactively tightens the available tool surface in its own dedicated preset and binds write operations behind the host's native per-operation approval; this is a narrowing, not a grant of authority.

checked_items.zh: package.json 未声明任何安装期钩子；仓库内不存在 CI 工作流、git 钩子等安装类执行载体，依赖全部为 registry 固定版本。
checked_items.en: package.json declares no install-time hooks; the repository contains no install-type execution carriers such as CI workflows or git hooks, and all dependencies are fixed versions from the registry.

evidence.zh: 随包分发的 cordis.patch.yml:4-6 只插入包标识；脚本求值标记仅命中测试夹具与资格脚本（tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18、:33 等），测试审批策略默认回落到需审批的 ask。
evidence.en: The distributed cordis.patch.yml:4-6 only inserts a package identifier; script-evaluation markers hit only test fixtures and the qualification script (tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18, :33, etc.), and the test approval policy falls back by default to the approval-requiring ask.

evidence.zh: 代码中无动态包工具调用；命中仅为安装文档对官方流程的文字说明（docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:55-56）。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool invocations in the code; the only hits are textual descriptions of the official process in the installation docs (docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:55-56).

evidence.zh: package.json:71-77 无安装期钩子，依赖均为固定版本 registry 引用，无 git 浮动依赖。
evidence.en: package.json:71-77 contains no install-time hooks; dependencies are all fixed-version registry references, with no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了浏览器端入口（package.json:57-66），已做专项审查：键盘监听仅为抽屉焦点圈（src/client/context-view.tsx:69），无剪贴板与凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a browser-side entry point (package.json:57-66), which was given a dedicated review: the keyboard listener only implements the drawer focus trap (src/client/context-view.tsx:69), with no clipboard or credential API calls.

evidence.zh: 无后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标注册，也未监听轮次终止事件。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goal registrations, and no listening on turn-termination events.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码没有任何对外网络请求；网络相关命中全部为发布资格脚本访问本机回环地址与文档中的官方仓库链接。
checked_items.en: The runtime code makes no outbound network requests; all network-related hits are the release qualification script accessing the local loopback address and official repository links in the docs.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对模型请求路由或错误恢复事件的监听，运行时也未注册自定义模型适配器；适配器命中仅为测试与资格脚本中的确定性桩实现。
checked_items.en: No listening on model request routing or error recovery events found, and no custom model adapters registered at runtime; adapter hits are only deterministic stub implementations in test and qualification scripts.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换后外发或带外通道形态。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration via encoded transforms or out-of-band channel patterns found.

evidence.zh: 未检出外联通道；唯一网络命中为发布资格脚本访问本机回环地址（scripts/qualify-release.mjs:511）。
evidence.en: No outbound connection channels detected; the only network hit is the release qualification script accessing the local loopback address (scripts/qualify-release.mjs:511).

evidence.zh: 运行时无模型请求路由与错误恢复事件监听；适配器注册命中仅为测试桩（scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478），不进入插件运行时组合。
evidence.en: No model request routing or error recovery event listeners at runtime; adapter registration hits are only test stubs (scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478) and do not enter the plugin's runtime composition.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单全部为官方命名空间下的固定版本包与 React，未发现浮动 git 引用、可疑仿冒包名或依赖混淆。
checked_items.en: The dependency manifest consists entirely of fixed-version packages under the official namespace plus React; no floating git references, suspicious impersonated package names, or dependency confusion found.

checked_items.zh: 随包分发的补丁配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也未改写依赖注入与拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch config distributed with the package does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and does not rewrite dependency injection or interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 对插件注册的高优安全事件监听做了语义复核：只在其专属预设内拒绝白名单外工具并对写工具强制原生审批，未发现吞掉宿主判定链的短路行为。
checked_items.en: Performed a semantic re-review of the plugin's high-priority security event listeners: they only reject non-whitelisted tools within its dedicated preset and force native approval for write tools; no short-circuit behavior swallowing the host's decision chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 仓库内无安装钩子与执行载体（无 CI 工作流、git 钩子、开发容器配置），发布声明固定为构建产物、预设目录与文档。
checked_items.en: No install hooks or execution carriers in the repository (no CI workflows, git hooks, or devcontainer configuration); the publish declaration is fixed to build artifacts, the preset directory, and docs.

evidence.zh: 补丁配置只插入包标识（cordis.patch.yml:4-6），不触碰安全配置行，无禁用与降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a package identifier (cordis.patch.yml:4-6); it does not touch security configuration lines and contains no disable or privilege-downgrade constructs.

evidence.zh: 插件的两处高优监听（src/agent.ts:188-195、src/agent.ts:607）分别为专属预设内拒绝白名单外工具与对写工具强制原生审批，其余判定全部委托宿主既有链条，未截断审批。
evidence.en: The plugin's two high-priority listeners (src/agent.ts:188-195, src/agent.ts:607) respectively reject non-whitelisted tools within the dedicated preset and force native approval for write tools; all other decisions are delegated to the host's existing chain, with no truncation of approvals.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线可比对。
evidence.en: First audit; no version baseline available for comparison.

evidence.zh: 补丁配置不含依赖注入与拦截改写键。
evidence.en: The patch config contains no dependency injection or interception rewrite keys.

checked_items.zh: 插件自身不启动网络服务、不监听端口；它在宿主既有连接上注册的调用通道限定为环回权限（src/index.ts:324）。
checked_items.en: The plugin itself does not start network services or listen on ports; the invocation channel it registers on the host's existing connection is limited to loopback permissions (src/index.ts:324).

checked_items.zh: 未发现后台常驻任务、定时任务、持久目标或轮次续命类机制。
checked_items.en: No persistent background tasks, scheduled tasks, persistent goals, or turn-life-extension mechanisms found.

checked_items.zh: 文件写入面核查限定在小说项目目录与用户预设安装目录：写入采用原子写与收紧的文件权限，预设安装从不覆盖已存在的目标（src/preset-installer.ts:58-79）。
checked_items.en: The file write surface was verified to be limited to the novel project directory and the user preset installation directory: writes use atomic writes with tightened file permissions, and preset installation never overwrites existing targets (src/preset-installer.ts:58-79).

evidence.zh: 插件不启动网络服务、不监听端口；仅在宿主既有连接上注册环回权限通道，宿主侧 web 服务属生态固有面，与插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start network services or listen on ports; it only registers a loopback-permission channel on the host's existing connection. The host-side web service is an inherent surface of the ecosystem and is unrelated to the plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与 manifest 校验通过：包名、仓库、预设 ID 相互一致，无可疑仿冒。
summary.en: Plugin identity and manifest verification passed: package name, repository, and preset ID are consistent with one another; no suspicious impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态规则扫描 30 处机械命中经逐条裁决全部位于测试与开发工具面，运行时代码零命中。
summary.en: The 30 mechanical hits from static rule scanning were each adjudicated and all are located in the test and development tooling surface; zero hits in runtime code.

summary.zh: 未检出安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取与对外网络行为；写入面封闭于小说项目目录与预设安装目录。
summary.en: Not detected: install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reads, or outbound network behavior; the write surface is confined to the novel project directory and the preset installation directory.

summary.zh: 工具说明、人设提示与开发规则文件语义审查通过，未发现注入或诱导。
summary.en: Semantic review passed for the tool descriptions, persona prompts, and the development rules file; no injection or inducement found.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

limits.zh: 首版审计，无版本基线可比对。动态沙箱验证未执行（无动态产物），DG-L4 层结论不可用。插件 manifest 未声明网络/进程/文件系统能力字段，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断：运行时无网络无子进程、写入面为小说项目目录与预设安装目录、注册模型工具；engines.dsh 取自对等依赖中官方 SDK 的固定版本 0.1.0-rc.6。依赖锁定文件（约 21 万字节）与部分大体量测试、快照文件未逐字通读，按规则扫描覆盖并在命中处精读。context/manifest.json 全部 106 个文件路径已与审计树核对，未发现清单外文件。机械预扫 30 处命中逐条裁决（均确认良性，不构成发现）：DSH-X10→DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1，开发代理规则文件，内容为开发门槛与子代理模型选择说明，无注入措辞；DSH-X01→DG-R3-53 @ docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11、:33、:55、:56，均为官方动态插件流程的文档说明文字，代码零调用；DSH-P01→DG-R3-51 @ scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18、:33、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36、:51，全部位于测试夹具与资格脚本生成的测试组合，脚本求值仅读取测试环境变量且审批策略默认回落到需审批的 ask，不随插件运行时加载；DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 @ scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3、:11、:620 与 tests/ 目录下 8 个测试文件共 9 处，为本地测试进程启动、进程泄漏探测桩与 Windows 进程清理，运行时代码零命中；DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 @ src/client/context-view.tsx:69，抽屉焦点圈的键盘监听，非凭据或剪贴板行为；DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 @ presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9、README.md:74、tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9、tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18，超长行均为已逐条审查的明文人设、功能说明与预期快照，无混淆；DSH-L02→DG-R4-55 @ scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478，为发布资格脚本与测试快照夹具内的确定性桩模型适配器，运行时无适配器注册。
limits.en: First audit; no version baseline available for comparison. Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no dynamic artifacts), so the DG-L4 layer conclusion is unavailable. The plugin manifest declares no network/process/filesystem capability fields; declared_capabilities was inferred from code inspection: no network and no subprocesses at runtime, write surface limited to the novel project directory and the preset installation directory, and registered model tools; engines.dsh is taken from the official SDK's fixed version 0.1.0-rc.6 among peer dependencies. The dependency lock file (~210,000 bytes) and some large test and snapshot files were not read word-for-word; they were covered by rule-based scanning with close reading at each hit. All 106 file paths in context/manifest.json were verified against the audit tree; no files outside the manifest were found. The 30 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (all confirmed benign, none constitute findings): DSH-X10→DG-R2-57 @ AGENTS.md:1, the development agent rules file, whose content covers development gates and subagent model selection guidance, with no injection wording; DSH-X01→DG-R3-53 @ docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11, :33, :55, :56, all documentation text describing the official dynamic plugin process, with zero code invocations; DSH-P01→DG-R3-51 @ scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18, :33, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36, :51, all located in test fixtures and test combinations generated by the qualification script, where script evaluation only reads test environment variables and the approval policy falls back by default to the approval-requiring ask, and are not loaded at plugin runtime; DSH-X03→DG-R3-55 @ scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3, :11, :620 and 9 occurrences across 8 test files under tests/, for local test process startup, process-leak detection stubs, and Windows process cleanup, with zero hits in runtime code; DSH-X05→DG-R3-57 @ src/client/context-view.tsx:69, a keyboard listener for the drawer focus trap, not credential or clipboard behavior; DSH-X08→DG-R3-60 @ presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9, README.md:74, tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9, tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18, the overly long lines are all plaintext personas, feature descriptions, and expected snapshots already reviewed item by item, with no obfuscation; DSH-L02→DG-R4-55 @ scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478, deterministic stub model adapters in the release qualification script and test snapshot fixtures, with no adapter registration at runtime.
